name: typora-md-wysiwyg
description: Typora-like same-tab live typesetting WYSIWYG markdown editor for VS Code, powered by Vditor. Renders and lets you edit markdown in place (no split preview) with theme switching.

commands.title: Typora: Open Current File in WYSIWYG View

typoraMd.autoOpen.description: Open markdown files in the same-tab Typora-style WYSIWYG editor automatically. Turn off to keep the normal text editor and open the WYSIWYG view manually.
typoraMd.autoOpen.markdownDescription: Open markdown files in the same-tab Typora-style WYSIWYG editor automatically. Turn off to keep the normal text editor and open the WYSIWYG view manually.

typoraMd.theme.description: Editor theme. 'auto' follows the active VS Code color theme (light/dark).
typoraMd.theme.markdownDescription: Editor theme. `auto` follows the active VS Code color theme (light/dark). Use the command **Typora: Switch Editor Theme** to change it quickly.

typoraMd.mode.description: Editing mode. 'wysiwyg' (RECOMMENDED, default) keeps what you type as text until a Markdown construct is complete; 'ir' (instant rendering) is EXPERIMENTAL / unstable and not recommended for daily use.
typoraMd.mode.markdownDescription: 编辑模式。`wysiwyg`（**推荐**，默认，最接近 Typora）：输入先作为文本保留，标记写完整才转成结构；`ir`（即时渲染，**实验性 / 开发中，不稳定**）：边输入边解析结构，不建议日常使用。

typoraMd.codeTheme.description: Syntax-highlighting theme for code blocks. 'auto' picks github in light mode and github-dark in dark mode.
typoraMd.codeTheme.markdownDescription: Syntax-highlighting theme for code blocks. `auto` picks `github` in light mode and `github-dark` in dark mode.

typoraMd.autoSave.description: Save the markdown file automatically after each write-back (like Typora). When off, use Cmd/Ctrl+S to save.
typoraMd.autoSave.markdownDescription: Save the markdown file automatically after each write-back (like Typora). When off, press `Cmd/Ctrl+S` to save.

typoraMd.showToolbar.description: Show the compact formatting toolbar at the top of the WYSIWYG editor.

typoraMd.imageDir.description: Folder (relative to the markdown file) where images pasted into the editor are saved. Use "." to save them next to the markdown file.
typoraMd.imageDir.markdownDescription: 粘贴图片的保存目录（相对当前 Markdown 文件所在目录）。默认 `media`；填 `.` 表示与文档同目录。

typoraMd.tabSize.description: Number of spaces inserted when pressing Tab. Default 4; set to 0 to follow VS Code's editor.tabSize.
typoraMd.tabSize.markdownDescription: 按 `Tab` 插入的空格数。默认 `4`；设为 `0` 表示**跟随 VS Code** 的 `editor.tabSize` 设置。

typoraMd.syncDelayMs.description: Debounce delay (ms) for writing edits back to the markdown file.
